title: All aboard the Sophie/Sophia express!
text:
Our guide was Sophie/Sophia. Some of us heard Sophie and some of us heard 
Sophia.  She was amazing, she immediately picked up that we were all experienced Segway riders and gave us the  advanced tour.  She was both entertaining and informative.  She also gave us a great dinner recommendation to eat at Elsa Y Fred.  My favorite dinner in Barcelona.
author: richardpB9264US

title: Highly recommend
text: Fantastic tour of the city. Max was a great tour guide. Segways were so much fun. Highly recommend.
author: kitkatcaddy

title: Great tour and guide!
text: The tour was a fun and fast way for us to experience a large area of Barcelona.   These highlights allowed us to decide where to spend more of our time afterwards.   Our tour guide Max was very informative and kept the tour going at an active and safe pace.
author: Alex_B

title: Fun Fun Fun
text: We had an amazing Segway journey around Barcelona with the awesome Max. He was fun and friendly and we loved all the places he took us. Highly recommend this tour as an alternative to just walking. Big thank you to Max. SO MUCH FUN!!
author: Pathfinder560959

title: A positive experience. Thanks Sun & Segway
text: Great tour, unforgettable emotions from the Segway. Guides are very positive and attentive. Highly recommended. Two hours went by without being noticed.
